display.purpose: One Bodoni h1 per page: 52-96px home, 56-88px category, 44-56px product.

headline.purpose: Section and collection titles, balanced wrap.

title.purpose: Product names in the grid (17/21px), step titles (24px), review heading (28px).

body.purpose: Running text, greige for secondary copy.

label.purpose: Navigation, buttons, text links, field and spec labels, tabs.

figures.purpose: Prices and sizes in lining tabular Bodoni; 64px for the product page size.

shadows.name: hairline-inset
shadows.purpose: Secondary button outline (full ivory on hover); a border, not elevation.

shadows.name: focus-underline
shadows.purpose: Thickens the underlined field rule to 2px on focus.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Boxed field and choice tile focus or selection.

shadows.name: header-glass
shadows.purpose: Sticky header; solid canvas under reduced transparency.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for state transitions (150ms) and photo zoom.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Hero triptych entrance; fade only under reduced motion.

motion.name: photo-zoom
motion.purpose: Photo hover on hover-capable devices; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled button per view: ivory rectangle, black tracked caps.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Hairline ivory outline for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{font-family:var(--font-sans, Jost, Futura, 'Century Gothic', sans-serif);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0.2em;line-height:1.4;text-transform:uppercase;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:48px;padding:0 28px;background:transparent;color:var(--color-label,#eeeae3);border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(238 234 227/0.45);cursor:pointer;transition:box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1),transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1);}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-label,#eeeae3);}.ds-btn-secondary:active{transform:scale(0.98);}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--color-brass,#cdb184);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Tracked caps link underlined in brass.

components.name: Underlined Field
components.description: Floating-label field on a single rule that turns brass on focus.
components.css: .ds-field{position:relative;width:260px;font-family:var(--font-sans, Jost, Futura, 'Century Gothic', sans-serif);}.ds-field input{width:100%;height:56px;padding:18px 40px 0 0;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-control,#6e6961);border-radius:0;color:var(--color-label,#eeeae3);font:inherit;font-size:17px;caret-color:var(--color-brass,#cdb184);transition:border-color 150ms ease;}.ds-field input:focus{outline:none;border-bottom-color:var(--color-brass,#cdb184);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--color-brass,#cdb184);}.ds-field label{position:absolute;left:0;top:28px;transform:translateY(-50%);transform-origin:left;font-size:17px;line-height:1;color:var(--color-label-2,#a8a197);pointer-events:none;transition:transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1);}.ds-field input:focus+label,.ds-field input:not(:placeholder-shown)+label{transform:translateY(calc(-50% - 10px)) scale(0.7);}.ds-field-unit{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:9px;font-size:17px;color:var(--color-label-2,#a8a197);}

components.name: Underlined Tabs
components.description: Sibling-page tabs; current page ivory with a brass rule.
components.html: Pour moi (8)Tout voir (15)
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:24px;}.ds-tabs a{font-family:var(--font-sans, Jost, Futura, 'Century Gothic', sans-serif);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0.2em;line-height:1.4;text-transform:uppercase;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;color:var(--color-label-2,#a8a197);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:color 150ms ease,border-color 150ms ease;}.ds-tabs a:hover{color:var(--color-label,#eeeae3);}.ds-tabs a[aria-current=page]{color:var(--color-label,#eeeae3);border-bottom-color:var(--color-brass,#cdb184);}.ds-tabs a:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--color-brass,#cdb184);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Size Chips
components.description: Square size selector; computed size ringed in brass, sold out struck through.
components.css: .ds-chips{display:flex;gap:8px;}.ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:48px;min-width:56px;padding:0 12px;background:transparent;color:var(--color-label,#eeeae3);border:0;border-radius:0;font-family:var(--font-sans, Jost, Futura, 'Century Gothic', sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-separator,#2e2b27);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease,box-shadow 150ms ease,color 150ms ease;}.ds-chip:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-control,#6e6961);}.ds-chip-mine{outline:1px solid var(--color-brass,#cdb184);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-chip-on{background:var(--color-label,#eeeae3);color:var(--color-on-accent,#0c0b0a);box-shadow:none;}.ds-chip:disabled{color:rgb(168 161 151/0.8);text-decoration:line-through;box-shadow:none;cursor:default;}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--color-brass,#cdb184);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Size Badge
components.description: Brass size set on the bottom-left of each product photo.
components.css: .ds-photo{position:relative;width:200px;aspect-ratio:4/5;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2a2622,#0c0b0a);}.ds-badge{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 12px;background:rgb(12 11 10/0.8);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);}.ds-badge-label{font-family:var(--font-sans, Jost, Futura, 'Century Gothic', sans-serif);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0.2em;line-height:1.4;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:10px;color:var(--color-label-2,#a8a197);}.ds-badge-size{font-family:var(--font-display, 'Bodoni Moda', 'Bodoni 72', Didot, Georgia, serif);font-variant-numeric:lining-nums tabular-nums;font-size:17px;line-height:1;color:var(--color-brass,#cdb184);}

narrative.overview:
Carrure reads like an Italian tailoring house after closing time: a warm black room, ivory type, and one brass fitting that catches the light. The garment is photographed like a campaign, worn and cropped below the chin on a dark ground, and the computed size is set beside it the way a price tag is set in a shop window, in brass Bodoni numerals. Everything else steps back.

The system is quiet and rectangular. Didone titles at text weight carry the voice; Jost in tracked small capitals carries every instruction (navigation, buttons, field labels, spec terms). Structure comes from hairlines (#2e2b27) and tonal steps of the warm black, never from cards, shadows or rounded containers. Density is low: generous section breaks, centered titles, and photography given the full width of the grid.

The world replaced a bright Apple Store tile look, rejected by the user as cheap. That rejection is a confirmed anti-reference: no light grey tiles, no pill buttons, no rounded cards, no saturated system blue.
keyCharacteristics: Warm black ground, ivory text, a single brass accent reserved for the size and for focus.
Bodoni Moda titles at weight 400, never bold; Jost body; tracked small caps for every control.
Square corners on every surface and control; round only for small markers (badge count, gauge knob, spinner).
Hairline separators and tonal layering instead of elevation.
Worn-garment photography on dark backgrounds with one shared grade, 4:5 frames.

rules.name: The One Brass Rule
rules.body: Brass marks the visitor's size, focus and links, nothing decorative. If a screen has brass on something that is not the size, a link underline, focus or a step numeral, remove it.

rules.name: The Ivory Button Rule
rules.body: The filled primary button is ivory on black, not brass. One filled button per view; everything else is an outline or a text link.

rules.name: The Text-Weight Rule
rules.body: Every h1 to h3 is Bodoni at weight 400 with -0.005em tracking. Hierarchy comes from size and space, never from bold.

rules.name: The Estimated Underline Rule
rules.body: An estimated value carries a 1px dotted Thread Grey underline; a measured value does not. Never remove it to tidy the page: it is the honesty signal.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px Hairline rule or a tonal step. If you reach for a drop shadow, use a rule instead.

dos: Do keep the ground warm black (canvas) and text ivory (label); secondary text greige (label-2).
Do reserve brass for the visitor's size, focus, link underlines and step numerals.
Do set every h1 to h3 in Bodoni Moda at weight 400; set every price and size in lining tabular Bodoni figures.
Do set navigation, buttons, field and spec labels in 11px Jost 500, 0.2em tracking, uppercase.
Do keep every corner square; round only badge counts, the gauge knob and the spinner.
Do separate content with 1px hairlines and tonal steps; keep photos 4:5, worn, dark-ground, cropped below the chin, in the shared grade.
Do mark estimated values with the dotted underline and keep 44px minimum hit areas on links.
donts: Don't return to the Apple Store look: no light grey tiles, no pill or rounded buttons, no rounded cards, no system blue.
Don't use bold Bodoni or a second accent color.
Don't add drop shadows for elevation.
Don't fill a button in brass or use more than one filled button per view.
Don't use text glyphs as icons; draw icons as 1.2px-stroke outline SVG.
Don't place a tracked-caps label above a title as decoration; tracked caps label controls and data.
